ux_intent: Validate that all 13 search fields have persistent, visible labels that do not disappear on input, and that keyboard or switch-access focus traverses the form in the correct logical order.
figma_make_prompt:
Build an advanced search form screen for the Hoopla digital library app.

Platform: mobile (iOS and Android), 390x844 base frame.
Use a top app bar with title "Advanced Search" and a back arrow.

Layout:
- Vertical scroll with 16px horizontal padding, 12px vertical gap between fields.
- 13 input fields in order: Title, People, Keyword, Availability, Format, Borrow Type, Release Date, Date Added, Language, Series, Publisher, ISBN, Genre.
- Each field is a TextInputLayout container:
  - Floating label (Body Small, 14sp). Secondary colour #6B7280 when unfocused and empty; primary colour #6366F1 when focused or filled. Floats above the input when focused or filled, sits inside the input at placeholder position when unfocused and empty.
  - Input field (Body Medium, 16sp, #121212). Height 48dp. Bottom border 1px #E5E7EB default, 2px #6366F1 when focused.
  - Optional helper text below (Caption, 12sp, #6B7280).
- Bottom of scroll: 8px gap, then two full-width buttons stacked with 8px gap — "Search" (primary filled, 48dp) and "Clear All" (secondary outlined, 48dp).

States:
- Default: all fields empty, labels at placeholder position in #6B7280, helper text visible.
- Focused: active field label floated up in #6366F1, 2px primary bottom border.
- Filled: label stays floated, input shows entered text.
- Error: field border turns #EF4444, helper text replaced by error message in #EF4444 (Caption). Example: "Release date must be a valid date".
- Results: after tapping Search, a linear progress indicator replaces the button text briefly, then a result-count banner (Body Small, 14sp, #6B7280) appears above the form: "Showing 42 results".

Behavior:
- Tap any field → field gains focus, label floats up.
- Tap "Search" → show progress on button, then show result-count banner.
- Tap "Clear All" → all fields reset to empty, labels return to default.
- Tab or next-field gesture → focus advances to the next field in the listed order. No fields are skipped.

Style:
- Material 3-ish, neutral. Background #FFFFFF. Primary #6366F1. Error #EF4444. Auto layout, responsive.
- All input fields 48dp height minimum. Labels 14sp minimum.

First step: default state with all 13 fields visible, labels in unfocused position, and both action buttons at the bottom.
ui_acceptance_criteria:
Given the user taps into any of the 13 fields and begins typing
When text is entered
Then the field label remains visible above the input and does not disappear

Given the form is in its default state
When the user views it
Then all 13 fields are present with distinct labels in the correct order from Title to Genre

Given the user taps Search with an invalid field value
When validation runs
Then the invalid field shows an inline error message in red below the input and the border turns red

Given the user taps Search with valid inputs
When results are returned
Then a result-count banner appears above the form and the Search button returns to its default state
manual_validation_checklist: Confirm all 13 field labels are present and readable in both unfocused (placeholder) and focused (floated) positions
Verify floating-label behaviour: label is above the input when focused or filled, inside when empty and unfocused
Check field order matches the specified sequence: Title, People, Keyword … Genre
Measure all input fields: height ≥ 48dp. Label text ≥ 14sp in both positions
Verify error state: red border #EF4444, red error text Caption 12sp, cleanly replaces helper text with no layout shift
Confirm Search and Clear All buttons are full-width, 48dp tall, and visually distinct (filled vs outlined)
Check that the result-count banner does not overlap any form content
